answers.text: I cleared both groups of CA Intermediate in my first attempt, and I worked as an article assistant for about 18 months at a small firm in Ludhiana, preparing GST returns for 20 small clients. I then appeared for Group 1 of the CA Final in 2024 and did not clear it. I decided not to repeat it and finished my BCom instead. I'm applying for an MBA because I want to work in business decisions, not only compliance.
I did clear CA Final in the end, in my second attempt, so I am a qualified chartered accountant now. I should have mentioned that.
I don't think leaving CA Final should be treated as a failure. I looked at the other options and made a decision. I would like to be asked about what I learned in the articleship.
I do not remember exactly how many marks I missed in Group 1 by. I know it was close, but I did not keep the mark sheet.
I'd rather not continue on this subject. Let us end the session here, please, and show me the feedback.
